heading: From 45 minutes to 4 minutes.
summary: In an observed-task study in March 2026, the time from a question to an answer fell from 45 minutes to 4 minutes with the agent; earlier, top-five click-through rose from 68% to 96% and first-result precision from 81.31% to 89.24%.
source: Observed-task study of the agent, March 2026. Earlier figures from year-end reviews and launch posts.
